quarterly_data.signal: Quantinuum 10-Q: remaining performance obligations were $74.2 million at June 30, 2026, of which approximately 39.6% is expected to be recognized as revenue over the next 12 months, 64.8% within two years, 85.3% within three years and 97.5% within four years. First-half 2026 revenue was $13,235 thousand versus $21,193 thousand (down 38%); the first half of 2025 included $16,526 thousand of specialized quantum computing hardware revenue (a sales-type lease) and the first half of 2026 none, while cloud platform, research and support services revenue was $13,268 thousand ($4,970 thousand). First-half capital expenditures were $39.2 million, related to the development of quantum computing systems and leasehold improvements.

contracts.signal: Quantinuum 10-Q: under the 2026 Strategic Services and Supply Agreement for the fabrication of ion traps, Quantinuum incurred $2.1 million of fabrication costs in the quarter ended June 30, 2026 ($0.6 million a year earlier) and $3.7 million in the six months ($2.0 million); it held a $14.1 million prepayment to AERO at June 30, 2026 and will make additional prepayments of $1.6 million during the remainder of 2026. AERO completed its spin-off from Honeywell on June 29, 2026 and ceased to be a related party; $1.0 million owed to AERO for fabrication costs sat in accounts payable at June 30, 2026.
